customManagers.description: Bump the single ZigVersion (Vezel.Zig.Toolsets) pin; every other file derives from it. Loose versioning, because nuget versioning reads a bare 0.16.0.2 as the range >= 0.16.0.2, which every newer release already satisfies, so no update was ever proposed.

packageRules.description: The PackageReference in Crosscompile.targets uses an unexpanded MSBuild property ($(HostRuntimeIdentifier)) as the package name; the built-in NuGet manager cannot resolve it (the custom manager above handles the real bump), so ignore it.

prBodyNotes: :warning: Zig releases change behaviour relevant to this package. Work through the **[ZigVersion bump checklist](docs/zig-version-bump.md)** before merging — in particular the full-matrix dispatch (`full_matrix=true`), since a PR run only builds from three hosts.

packageRules.description: The task DLL compiles against the oldest MSBuild it must load in (17.8, the .NET 8 SDK), and the MSBuild tests match it. These are deliberate floors, not stale versions.
setup-dotnet's 8.0.x is the oldest supported SDK, kept on purpose so CI proves the package still works there. Raise it by hand when .NET 8 support is dropped.
